{{Short description|Type of linear operator}}
In mathematics, an '''eigenoperator''', ''A'', of a [[Matrix (mathematics)|matrix]] ''H'' is a [[linear operator]] such that

: <math> [H,A] = \lambda A \, </math>

where <math>\lambda</math> is a corresponding [[scalar (mathematics)|scalar]] called an [[eigenvalue]].<ref>{{cite book|last1=Gardiner|first1=Crispin|title=Quantum Noise|url=https://archive.org/details/quantumnoisehand00gard_085|url-access=limited|date=2000|publisher=Springer|page=[https://archive.org/details/quantumnoisehand00gard_085/page/n110 85]}}</ref>
